name: ReadFromExcelWorksheet
label: Read from Excel Worksheet
description: Reads values from a specified cell range in the given Excel worksheet.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet object from which to read data. If not provided, the active worksheet from the workbook will be used.

fields.name: RetrieveMode
fields.label: Retrieve Mode
fields.description: Specifies how to retrieve data from the worksheet.

selectOptions.label: The value of a single cell
selectOptions.description: Reads a single cell by column and row.

selectOptions.label: Values from a range of cells

fields.name: StartColumnIndex
fields.label: Start Column Index
fields.description: The starting column index (e.g., 1 for 'A'). Takes precedence if greater than 0.

fields.name: StartRow
fields.label: Start Row
fields.description: The starting row of the range to read.

fields.name: EndColumn
fields.label: End Column
fields.description: The ending column of the range to read (required if 'Retrieve Mode' is 'Range of Cells').

fields.name: EndColumnIndex
fields.label: End Column Index
fields.description: The ending column index (e.g., 4 for 'D'). Takes precedence if greater than 0.

fields.name: EndRow
fields.label: End Row
fields.description: The ending row of the range to read (required if 'Retrieve Mode' is 'Range of Cells').

fields.name: Name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: The name of the named range to read.

fields.name: GetContentsAsText
fields.label: Get Cell Contents as Text
fields.description: If true, retrieves cell contents as text; otherwise, retrieves raw values.

fields.name: FirstLineContainsColumnNames
fields.label: First Line of Range Contains Column Names
fields.description: If true, treats the first row as column names.

fields.name: OmitEmptyColumnsAndRows
fields.label: Omit Empty Columns and Rows
fields.description: If true, omits empty columns to the right and empty rows at the bottom.

fields.name: ExcelData
fields.label: Excel Data
fields.description: Returns the data read from the specified range as a DataTable.
